title: Effect of no cost sharing for paediatric care on healthcare usage by household income levels: regression discontinuity design.
authors: Fukuma S, Kato H, Takaku R, Tsugawa Y.
figures: Selection process of study participants. Figure shows selection process of study participants from the database. We excluded 13 children due to missing income level, 2888 children due to very high healthcare spending which is covered by the government and 130 787 children who live in the areas with income restrictions on subsidies. Finally, we analysed 244 549 children for the main analysis.
